using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;
if(args.Length!=1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Need X12 path");
var physical=GeneratedMapping.ParseNativePrimaryX12Source(File.ReadAllBytes(args[0]));
var root=ScopeContext.FromSource(physical);
var actual=new JsonArray();
var primaryProbes=new JsonArray();
foreach(var context in root.IterateSource("Interchange","Group","Message_850")) {
    if(context.ResolveSourceRootField(9000,new[]{"BEG","F1"}).Kind!=FerruleValueKind.Null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Walking messages must not retarget Primary");
    primaryProbes.Add((JsonNode?)null);
    var document=GeneratedMapping.PreparePrimaryX12JsonMessage(context) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing document");
    actual.Add(new JsonObject { ["path"]=document.Path,["value"]=JsonNode.Parse(GeneratedMapping.SerializeMapForceJson(document.Value)) });
}
var expected=JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(args[0])!,"expected.json")));
File.WriteAllText(Path.ChangeExtension(args[0],"csharp-native-results.json"),new JsonObject { ["actual"]=actual.DeepClone(),["expected"]=expected!.DeepClone(),["physical_primary_probes"]=primaryProbes }.ToJsonString());
if(!JsonNode.DeepEquals(actual,expected)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Native convenience mismatch: {actual}");
Console.WriteLine("3 physical-envelope message convenience entries passed");
